name: connect-other-ais
description: A multi-model review gate: secondary vendor models (Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek) review your main AI's plan and code in rounds, until the findings drop under a threshold or a human is called.

commands.title: ConnectOtherAIs: Copy the MCP config block

coai.providers.markdownDescription: Which secondary vendors review. `deepseek` needs a key in the CredsForDevs config entry (`#coai.credsKey#`).

coai.model.codex.description: Model for the Codex CLI (-m). Empty = the CLI's own default.

coai.model.gemini.description: Model for the Gemini CLI (-m). Empty = the CLI's own default.

coai.model.deepseek.description: DeepSeek model (rides the Codex CLI's custom provider). Empty = the CLI's own default.

coai.maxRounds.description: Review rounds per stage before the on-exhausted policy fires.

coai.gateThreshold.description: The gate passes when blocking+major findings (after de-duplication) are at or under this.

coai.onExhausted.markdownDescription: When rounds run out with findings still gating: `continue` as-is (said out loud), call a `human`, or `escalate` the ladder (reviewer effort → reviewer model → arbiter model).

coai.maxConcurrency.description: Reviewer CLI processes running at once, machine-wide.

coai.maxPerProvider.description: Reviewer CLI processes per vendor at once — a rate limit is per vendor.

coai.credsKey.markdownDescription: The CredsForDevs **config-entry key** (minted by *Enable Code Access…* on the entry holding vendor API keys). A pass to one vault entry — revocable, useless while VS Code is closed — not a secret itself. Empty = keyless vendors only.

coai.language.description: The language you are asked in, and answer in. A question already written in it is left alone.

enumDescriptions: Never translate — always show the original
coai.translator.provider.description: Which small, fast model translates a question that is not already in your language.

coai.translator.model.description: The translator's model. Empty uses the CLI's own default.

coai.escalationMinutes.description: How long a question waits for you before the AI is told to ask in the chat instead.

scripts.package: npm run test && npm run bundle && vsce package --no-dependencies
